main.description: Represents git-push operation to target repository.

seq.description: The stream sequence number of this message.

repo.description: The repo this event comes from.

pusher.description: The account that performed this push.

items.description: List of git reference update operations in this push.

time.description: Timestamp of when this message was originally broadcast.

sig.description: Signature over the DAG-CBOR of this message with the seq and sig keys absent (repo/pusher DID, edits, time, options), by the repo's atproto signing key. seq is excluded so a relay can reassign it without invalidating the signature.

name.description: Full git reference name, ie refs/heads/main.

new.description: Full hex object id the ref now points at.

old.description: Full hex object id the ref pointed at before.
